verifications.claim: The 1991–92 Michigan Wolverines men's basketball team featured the Fab Five: Chris Webber, Jalen Rose, Juwan Howard, Jimmy King, and Ray Jackson.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'The Fab Five was the 1991 University of Michigan men's basketball team recruiting class... Chris Webber (#4) and Jalen Rose (#5), Chicago native Juwan Howard (#25)... Jimmy King (#24) and Austin's Ray Jackson (#21).' R5: 'the talented freshman class, known as the Fab Five... Center: Juwan Howard; Power forward: Chris Webber; Small forward: Ray Jackson; Shooting guard: Jimmy King; Point guard: Jalen Rose.'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources explicitly identify the five players as the Fab Five recruiting class for the 1991-92 season.

verifications.claim: The Fab Five were the first all-freshman starting lineup to reach an NCAA title game.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'The Fab Five were the first team in NCAA history to compete in the championship game with all-freshman starters.'
verifications.reasoning: Direct and exact match in R1.

verifications.reasoning: Explicitly stated in R1 and supported in others.
